text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Argh! My heart wants nothing more<n>than to run! But
my legs just won't<n>move... I didn't know coming
up short<n>could be this painful.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
But after watching some other racers<n>training for
the Mile Championship, I<n>realize that everyone is
suffering<n>from various hardships too.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The deeper the despair, the greater<n>the hope that
comes from it! I will<n>rise... and spread hope to the
world!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
If my breathing won't cooperate with<n>me, then I'll
just have to work on my<n>explosive power! That's
my best bet<n>right now!
